latest_release.name: Mindcraft v0.1.4 | General Maintenance
latest_release.body:
Bug fixes, documentation updates, and stability.

## What's Changed
* added "goToSurface" skill/action by @Lawtro37
* Pathfinder improvments by @Ninot1Quyi
* Docker improvments by @htqkeku-eftc @Wuodan @uukelele
* Fix custom OpenAI endpoints by @uukelele in https://github.com/mindcraft-bots/mindcraft/pull/646
* Revise installation instructions in minecollab.md by @icwhite in https://github.com/mindcraft-bots/mindcraft/pull/701
* Improve connection stability for Paper/Spigot servers by @atiweb in https://github.com/mindcraft-bots/mindcraft/pull/704
* Updated default models
* Many general documentation fixes and stability improvements

## New Contributors
